dedupe_keys.name: bornes de comptage cyclistes et pietons chiffres ville de liege

description: Bornes de comptage cyclistes et piétons - Chiffres - Ville de Liège is a dataset listed in Spi open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Ville de Liège. Ce jeu de données fournit les chiffres du comptage des cyclistes et des piétons par les bornes de comptage installées sur le territoire de la Ville de Liège. Coverage: Wallonia. The portal files it under Transports, Mobilité. Its keywords are MOBILITY IN LIEGE METROPOLE. The portal shows 127,032 records. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal shows 2021-08-30 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC BY (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-spi-digitalwallonia-portal.
